## About

Dogs R Us Collingwood is a home-style dog daycare and boarding business at 14 Balsam St. The brand specializes in little dogs (18″ paw-to-back or under). Proudly serving Collingwood, Ontario — including Blue Mountain, Wasaga Beach, Clearview and Thornbury. Every dog needs a Meet & Greet and a signed waiver before daycare.

## Service area

- Blue Mountain / The Blue Mountains

## Services

- Dog daycare in Collingwood — full day $50, half day $30 (up to 5 hrs), shoppers special $20 (up to 3 hrs); +HST — details on /little-dog-daycare
- Dog boarding in Collingwood — little dogs only — $75 +HST / 24 hours (includes a full daycare day)
- Treats R Us — house-made dehydrated single-ingredient treats; shipping available

## Booking

No online booking forms. Call or text Tracie at 705-606-4145. Documents: waiver and policy PDFs linked from the little dog daycare page.
